reasoning: A test taker asks how to stay fresh during the exam's breaks. It is a tactics question and names no problem such as stress or fatigue hurting them.
The writer says they get stressed a lot and fear stress will ruin their GRE. This is GRE stress hurting performance.
The writer asks how to manage test anxiety to perform their best on the GRE. It names anxiety directly but does not say how bad theirs is.
The writer wants to raise quant from 157 to 165 within a month. They are short of their quant target.
